messages.author: Shakir Ali Siddiqui
messages.body:
Dear Developers,
I am new to Amber and got to know that we can implement the oscillating
electric field in Amber with the help of the 'effreq' keyword.
But I am unable to find the unit of the electric field frequency that is
used in Amber Package.
I will be very thankful if someone helps me get to know the unit of
frequency.
Thanks in Advance
Shakir Ali Siddiqui
PhD Research Scholar
C/O- Dr. Kshatresh Dutta Dubey
Dept. of Chemistry, SoNS,
Shiv Nadar University, Gautam Buddha Nagar,
Uttar Pradesh, India, 201314
